verses.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮੂਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਜਾਣੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhiaan mool gur dharasano pooran braham jaan jaanoiee|

en.bdb: The glimpse of the Guru is the basis of meditation because Guru is Brahm and this fact is known to a rare one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜ ਮੂਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਣ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: pooj mool satigur charan kar gurdhev sev sukh hoiee|

en.bdb: The feet of true Guru, the root of all delights, should be worshipped and only then the delight would be atttained.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬਚਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਰਾਧੈ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ma(n)tr mool satigur bachan ik man hoi araadhai koiee|

en.bdb: The instructions of the true Guru is the basic formula (mantra) whose adoration with single minded devotion is undertaken by rare one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਖ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: mokh mool kirapaal gur jeevan mukat saadhasa(n)g soiee|

en.bdb: The basis of liberation is the grace of the Guru and one attains liberation in life in the holy congregation alone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਰਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: aap ganai na paieeaai aap gavai milai viraloiee|

en.bdb: Making oneself noticed none can attain the Lord and even shedding the ego any rare one meets Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: aap gavaae aap hai sabh ko aap aape sabh koiee|

en.bdb: He who annihilates his ego, in fact, is the Lord Himself; he knowns everyone as his form and all accept him as their form.
This way that individual in the form of Guru becomes disciple and the disciple is turned to be Guru.
